Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to the most common questions about commercial roofing restoration, maintenance, and repair services.

How long does a commercial roof restoration take?

Most commercial roof restorations take between a few days to a few weeks, depending on roof size, condition, and weather. We provide a detailed timeline after our initial inspection.

What is the difference between roof restoration and replacement?

Roof restoration involves repairing and recoating your existing roof to extend its life, typically at 50-70% less cost than full replacement. Replacement involves tearing off the old roof and installing a completely new system. In many cases, restoration is the more cost-effective solution.

How often should a commercial roof be inspected?

We recommend having your commercial roof inspected at least twice a year — once in spring and once in fall. Additional inspections should be done after severe weather events such as hail storms, high winds, or heavy snow.

Do you offer free roof inspections?

Yes, we offer free commercial roof inspections for businesses in our service area. Our inspection includes a thorough assessment of your roof's condition, documentation of any issues found, and recommendations for maintenance or restoration.

What areas do you serve?

We serve all of Southwest Michigan including Kalamazoo, Three Rivers, Portage, Schoolcraft, Vicksburg, and Sturgis. We also serve the broader West Michigan area and Northern Indiana.

What types of commercial roofs do you work on?

We work on all types of commercial roofing systems including flat roofs, metal roofs, TPO, EPDM, modified bitumen, built-up roofing, and more. Our team has experience with buildings of all sizes across various industries.

How do roof coatings help my commercial building?

Roof coatings create a seamless, waterproof barrier that protects your existing roof from UV damage, water intrusion, and weathering. They can also reflect sunlight, reducing cooling costs and extending your roof's lifespan by 10-20 years.

Can you help with insurance claims for storm damage?

Yes, we work with business owners throughout the insurance claims process for storm damage. We document all damage, provide detailed repair estimates, and work directly with your insurance adjuster to ensure your claim is handled properly.
